name: The Scarlet Crusade
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
You'll be happy to know we appear to be making progress in the mine, thanks in no small part to your efforts.  We can now turn our eyes to other concerns.

My scouts have reported that a detachment of the Scarlet Crusade is setting up a camp southeast of here. The Scarlet Crusade is a despicable organization that hunts us, and they will not rest until every undead--Lich King's Scourge or no--is destroyed. We must strike first!

Be careful, their unholy zeal makes them dangerous adversaries.
narrative.objectives: Bring Executor Arren 12 Scarlet Armbands from Scarlet Converts and Scarlet Initiates.
narrative.offerRewardText:
If only they listened to reason, eh, adventurer? Perhaps we could sit them down for reasonable discourse... ha!

Light-blinded fools.
narrative.requestItemsText: Those fools... They happily send themselves to their own graves.

chain.subtitle: 10 quests from level 2 to 12, 5,755 XP in all.

quests.name: The Damned
quests.objectiveText: Novice Elreth requires 6 Scavenger Paws and 6 Duskbat Wings.

quests.name: Night Web's Hollow
quests.objectiveText: Executor Arren wants you to kill 10 Young Night Web Spiders and 8 Night Web Spiders.

quests.name: The Scarlet Crusade
quests.objectiveText: Bring Executor Arren 12 Scarlet Armbands from Scarlet Converts and Scarlet Initiates.

quests.name: The Red Messenger
quests.objectiveText: Kill Meven Korgal, the messenger, at the Crusader camp, then return any information you find to Executor Arren.

quests.name: Vital Intelligence
quests.objectiveText: Deliver the Scarlet Crusade Documents to Executor Zygand in Brill.

quests.name: At War With The Scarlet Crusade
quests.objectiveText: Executor Zygand of Brill wants you to kill 10 Scarlet Warriors.

quests.name: Proof of Demise
quests.objectiveText: Bring 10 Scarlet Insignia Rings to Deathguard Burgess in Brill.

quests.name: At War With The Scarlet Crusade
quests.objectiveText: Executor Zygand in Brill wants you to kill Captain Perrine, 3 Scarlet Zealots and 3 Scarlet Missionaries.

quests.name: At War With The Scarlet Crusade
quests.objectiveText: Executor Zygand in Brill has commissioned you to slay Captain Vachon and 5 Scarlet Friars.

quests.name: At War With The Scarlet Crusade
quests.objectiveText: Executor Zygand in the town of Brill wants you to assassinate Captain Melrache and his two bodyguards.
